description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.

Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.

Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.

In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.

To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.

While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Coordenador de Operações
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

É responsável por coordenar, supervisionar e orientar as equipes de segurança, garantindo o cumprimento dos procedimentos e normas estabelecidas.

Ele realiza a elaboração das escalas de trabalho, alocação e reposição de pessoal conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Realiza o monitoramento e controle dos serviços em campo, com visitas periódicas aos postos de trabalho para assegurar a conformidade com os procedimentos operacionais padrão (POP) e normas de segurança vigentes.

Organiza treinamentos periódicos para a capacitação e atualização dos colaboradores, além de avaliar o desempenho da equipe e propor ações voltadas à melhoria contínua.

Gerencia o uso e manutenção dos equipamentos de segurança, como sistemas de vigilância, body cams e rádios, garantindo a operação adequada dos dispositivos e o correto armazenamento dos dados coletados.

Responsabiliza-se pelo controle dos materiais, equipamentos e uniformes, solicitando reposições quando necessário, bem como pela gestão dos custos operacionais e colaboração na elaboração de orçamentos.

Mantém contato frequente com os clientes para assegurar a satisfação com os serviços prestados, além de resolver questões e conflitos relacionados à operação.

Zela pelo cumprimento das legislações trabalhistas, normas de segurança privada e políticas internas da empresa, elaborando relatórios gerenciais e prestando contas à diretoria.

Coordena o gerenciamento de incidentes, investigando ocorrências, registrando relatórios e conduzindo ações corretivas, além de organizar respostas rápidas em situações de emergência.

Fornece suporte administrativo, controlando a documentação relacionada à operação, contratos e licenças, e apoiando processos de contratação, desligamento e avaliação de colaboradores.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Formação superior em Administração, Gestão de Segurança, Engenharia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em coordenação de equipes operacionais, preferencialmente no setor de segurança privada.
  • Conhecimento sólido das normas e legislações relacionadas à segurança privada e trabalhista.
  • Habilidade para liderar, motivar e desenvolver equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Capacidade de planejamento, organização e gerenciamento de recursos.
  • Experiência em controle de custos e elaboração de orçamentos operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de monitoramento, equipamentos de segurança e tecnologias associadas.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para negociação e resolução de conflitos.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo turnos, finais de semana e feriados.
  • Proatividade, capacidade de tomar decisões rápidas e trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão, softwares de controle operacional e pacote Office.
  • Carteira de habilitação válida (diferencial, caso haja necessidade de deslocamento entre unidades).

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição: R$ 37,85 p/dia
  • Vale Transporte
  • 30% de periculosidade

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

Professional certifications (e.g., PE, CEng, EMP, CEM) and experience in international or applied projects are an advantage.

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Payment

  • Paid contributions, with rates up to $13/hour*

Note: Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be offered to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

title: Planning and Integration Manager
description:
Planning and Integration Manager

Department: Administration

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, co-ordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.

Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.

title: Overlay Cluster Manager
description:
Overlay Cluster Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

Role to transition into onsite Overlay Venue Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and key stakeholders to define, optimize, and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Contribute to procurement and tendering processes by preparing technical inputs for RFPs, supporting technical evaluations, and managing overlay contractors and suppliers across assigned venues.
  • Manage change control and budget tracking for venues within the cluster, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule alignment.
  • Coordinate and oversee the flow of technical information, including drawings, requirements, and updates, across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain alignment with stadium authorities by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Oversee overlay delivery from planning through construction, operations, and reinstatement, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely handover.
  • Track progress, milestones, and deliverables, providing regular status updates and supporting the resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Support operational design development by consolidating raw data into compliant base drawings and ensuring consistent coding and naming conventions for effective tracking and change management.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese; additional language(s) is an asset.
  • Availability to travel as needed
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Senior Manager, Special Events

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world‑class event experiences that elevate the tournament’s global impact.

Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ special events. The role ensures seamless, high‑quality delivery aligned with FIFA’s brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament’s international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast‑paced, and multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

  • Official Dinner
  • Final Draw
  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick‑Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches
  • Participation in pre‑match ceremonies
  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA’s global positioning.

2. Creative Direction & Experience Design

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
  • Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup™.

3. Operational & Logistical Oversight

  • Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.
  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

4. Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
  • Manage protocol requirements and high‑profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

6. Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.
  • Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
  • Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

YOUR PROFILE

Education
  • A Master’s degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Additional executive education in large‑scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.
Experience
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
  • Proven experience leading high‑profile, broadcast‑level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government-level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi‑million-dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
  • Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega‑events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.
Skills & Competencies Strategic & Operational Excellence
  • Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
  • Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.
Leadership & Team Management
  • Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong decision‑making skills under pressure.
Financial & Commercial Acumen
  • Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost‑control expertise.
  • Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.
Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage high‑level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.
Personal Attributes
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
  • High integrity and alignment with FIFA’s values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.
Requiriments
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Overview:

We are seeking a Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear Specialist to join the Technical Services Division/ High Voltage Equipment Unit (HVEU). The Technical Services Division is responsible for providing and managing highly technical and specialized engineering services to support the safe and reliable operation of Saudi Aramco’s electrical transmission and distribution networks.   • Provide technical expertise on troubleshooting failures, repairs, and evaluating if the equipment is designed to meet its intended or existing service conditions.

  • Provide engineering input for switchgear work packages to ensure Saudi Aramco standards and material specifications are followed.
  • Review and update company standards and be familiar with international standards.

As a successful candidate you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years’ experience of operations and maintenance experience directly working with MV switchgear/control gear.
  • You will have In-depth knowledge, experience, and recognition as a switchgear specialist including membership of international engineering bodies and contribution at international conferences.
  • Background in the oil and gas industry or equipment manufacturers is a plus.
  • Professional Engineer certification such as chartership or PE is a plus.
  • You will have a working Knowledge of ANSI and IEC designed switchgear, breaker design (including mechanisms and interruption technology - vacuum, air, compressed air, SF-6), motor control gears, motor contactors, and pad-mounted SF-6 equipment.
  • You will have the ability to multi-task and manage changing priorities and seek opportunities to improve results and processes proactively, contributing to the goals, safety, and profitability of the company.
  • You will be able to integrate and quickly applying newly acquired technical information
  • You will have strong speaking, writing, and customer service skills.
  • You will also be able to complete daily work activities with limited supervision and able to work cooperatively in a team environment.

Work location: Within Saudi Arabia: On-Site

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose / ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Líder de Consultoria e Processos

Resumo do Propósito da Função :

Como um contribuinte fundamental para a excelência operacional, o Consultor de Processos & Melhoria Contínua (CI) conduz iniciativas impactantes de melhoria de processos em toda a organização. Atuando como um assessor de confiança, este cargo é responsável por padronizar, implementar e otimizar processos críticos para aumentar a eficiência e o desempenho. Utilizando sua expertise em melhoria contínua, o consultor garante que as soluções estejam alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais e entreguem resultados mensuráveis e sustentáveis, promovendo uma cultura de inovação e progresso contínuo.

O Consultor Interno de Processos & CI trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Head de Consultoria de Processos, assegurando alinhamento com a estratégia global e contribuindo para os objetivos mais amplos estabelecidos no plano de 5 anos (5YP) e em outras iniciativas estratégicas de negócios.

Responsabilidades :

  • Desenho Excelência Operacional e Otimização de Processos : apoiar e conduzir iniciativas de melhoria de processos destinadas a elevar a excelência operacional, simplificando processos, estimulando a inovação, melhorando a eficiência e desenvolvendo novas formas de trabalho. Realizar análises detalhadas para identificar ineficiências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos existentes, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Assegurar que as mudanças sejam sustentáveis, implementadas de forma eficaz e que seu impacto no desempenho seja mensurável.
  • Desenho e Otimização de Processos End-to-End (E2E) : atuar como consultor no design e implementação de processos operacionais eficientes, garantindo a criação de soluções robustas e escaláveis que ampliem o desempenho operacional em toda a organização. Ter um papel fundamental na tomada de decisões operacionais, garantindo que os processos sejam concebidos para serem replicáveis e adaptáveis em diferentes regiões e contextos. Oferecer suporte e assistência contínua no desenvolvimento de soluções operacionais personalizadas, alinhadas ao pipeline de desenvolvimento de Operações & TI, agilizando processos, sistemas e ferramentas para criar um ambiente de trabalho mais eficiente e eficaz.
  • Colaboração Multifuncional : atuar como elo entre as operações locais para facilitar o trabalho colaborativo entre equipes, assegurando alinhamento e compartilhamento de conhecimento para promover uma cultura de processos padronizados, disseminação de boas práticas e melhoria contínua.
  • Medição de Desempenho : desenvolver indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) para avaliar processos, desempenho de serviços e o impacto das iniciativas de melhoria, fornecendo insights aos stakeholders e apoiando ferramentas e sistemas que garantam dados provenientes de fontes válidas e integradas.
  • Programa de Melhoria Contínua : colaborar como parte da equipe global de Melhoria Contínua para executar, monitorar e aprimorar o programa. Engajar-se ativamente e apoiar a rede de colaboradores treinados para impulsionar projetos contínuos de melhoria de processos, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais e entregando ganhos de desempenho mensuráveis.
  • Colaboração Geográfica : apoiar equipes operacionais desde a Malásia até a Costa Rica, com base em prioridades definidas e em coordenação com o gestor direto, garantindo uma colaboração fluida e eficiente entre equipes / regiões.
  • Executar tarefas atribuídas pelo Head de Consultoria de Processos com base nas prioridades do ELT e iniciativas estratégicas.

Competências :

  • Adaptar o estilo de comunicação para transmitir mensagens de forma eficaz a diferentes públicos dentro das equipes e a stakeholders, garantindo clareza e promovendo compreensão nas interações do dia a dia.
  • Facilitar reuniões e discussões de equipe, assegurando que ações e prazos claros sejam definidos, mantendo a equipe alinhada e focada na entrega dos objetivos do projeto.
  • Construção de relações de trabalho positivas e promover a colaboração dentro das equipes de Operações (países e domínios) e com outros stakeholders, garantindo trabalho em equipe eficaz e partilha de ideias para apoiar o sucesso dos projetos.
  • Identificar proativamente áreas de melhoria e assumir a responsabilidade de impulsionar iniciativas de melhoria contínua dentro das diferentes equipas, garantindo progresso rumo aos objetivos operacionais.
  • Influenciar de forma eficaz colegas e membros da equipe para obter apoio às iniciativas de melhoria de processos, utilizando persuasão e colaboração para garantir alinhamento e implementação bem-sucedida das mudanças.

Essencial :

  • Proficiência na metodologia Lean Six Sigma (certificação Green Belt ou superior).
  • Experiência comprovada em mapeamento de processos e metodologias de melhoria de processos.
  • Experiência na implementação de ferramentas e técnicas de melhoria contínua, como Kaizen e DMAIC (Definir, Medir, Analisar, Melhorar, Controlar).
  • Capacidade de liderar projetos de melhoria de processos de ponta a ponta de forma eficaz.

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description: About BCP Securities Group Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world. Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship Position Description We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research. The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities. Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered. Main Responsibilities · Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators. · Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings. · Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets. · Track the performance and movements of financial assets. · Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts. · Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis. · Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials. · Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications. Requirements · Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory). · Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields. · Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments. · Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports. · Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail. · Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling). · Clear and structured written communication skills. · Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events. Differentials · Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets. · Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters. · Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI). Benefits · Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market. · Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm. · Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development. · Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Data Architect
description: About You You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization. Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora. Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development. Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance. Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance. Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation. Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance. Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

As an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer your primary role is to serve as an expert in Oil Reservoir Management, providing guidance and expert advice to the design, implementation, and optimization of best‑in‑class reservoir management programs for the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields. The position is embedded within Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical role, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

  • Maximize Net Present Value (NPV) and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and practice in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare critical reservoir engineering inputs for drilling and workover proposals and programs, recommending innovative completion techniques for complex well configurations, including: horizontal and multilateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies focused on optimizing ultimate recovery through reservoir stimulation modeling of various Improved Oil Recovery (IOR) processes.

  • Expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are preferred.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills. You will work closely with product managers and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. title: Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil
description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.

While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

This role reports to the CISO.

What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness

Optional things we value

  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

A Ortobom iniciou suas atividades em 1969, fabricando camas e mesas de metal. Atenta às novas tendências, a empresa passou a comprar blocos de espuma para a confecção de colchões, que harmoniosamente se casavam com as camas.

Em 1975, a Ortobom inaugurou no Rio de Janeiro a primeira fábrica especializada na fabricação de colchões. O objetivo era a produção e comercialização de colchões que proporcionassem o máximo de bem-estar e conforto aos clientes.

O sonho virou realidade. Hoje a Ortobom possui 12 fábricas e 400.000 m2 de área construída. São mais de 2.000 lojas no Brasil, com filiais também na Bolívia, Uruguai e Paraguai. O setor fabril, se somado, tem uma área superior a de grandes montadoras de automóveis.

A Ortobom é a maior produtora de colchões da América Latina e a 2ª maior produtora de espuma do mundo.

A qualidade é garantida através de um investimento constante em tecnologia, desde a matéria-prima ao maquinário. Toda essa estrutura só é possível graças ao potencial humano: são mais de 6.000 colaboradores, 1.000 franqueados e 5.000 consultores em todo o Brasil.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Realizar serviços hidráulicos relacionados a vazamentos de água em adutoras, rede, ramal, registro e cavalete;
  • Realizar instalação e substituição de hidrômetros, assim com a padronização de cavalete e ramal;
  • Executar a extensão de rede e a interligação em rede existente, oferecendo serviço de abastecimento de água;
  • Realizar manobras na rede de distribuição de água existente, instalar registro de manobra e descarga da rede;
  • Realizar a aferição da pressão de rede de distribuição de água e medidores;
  • Realizar demais atividades relacionadas a serviços de instalação/reparo e operação de água.

Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information

  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general track for Senior+ (Senior/Staff/Principal) Engineers in any team at Canonical. After the first round of interviews we will establish which teams might be an excellent fit, and progress your application with them.

At Canonical a Senior+ Engineer is not only an outstanding software architect and coder, they also demonstrate the leadership qualities needed to rally a team or department to ship outstanding products. A Senior+ Engineer partners with other Engineering leaders (Managers, Directors, VPs) to take joint responsibility for outcomes at team, department and company level. We hire based on academic results and proven execution, and we select those with a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will make a significant contribution in Canonical's portfolio through high-quality code, technical leadership, team motivation and direction, exceptional design, and crisp documentation.

As a Senior+ Engineer you'll drive the architecture, design and evolution of high-impact open source software. Our teams work at every level of the stack. From the kernel and system software at the core of Ubuntu through to major language runtimes and the bleeding-edge of cloud automation and distributed systems, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex but highly rewarding projects. Our teams also build the services which deliver Ubuntu to the world, on cloud, devices, servers and PCs.

Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.

Location: we have remote opportunities for Senior Engineers in every time zone.

The role entails

  • Leading design and architecture of an impactful open source project
  • Coding in Golang, Rust, Python, C/C++ or Typescript / React
  • Collaborating proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Mentoring, developing and advising colleagues in their career progression
  • Displaying technical leadership in Canonical and our communities
  • Debugging issues and producing high-quality code to fix them
  • Contributing to technical documentation with the aim to make it the best of its kind
  • Working from home with global travel twice annually for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Technical leadership as well as team motivation, direction and pace
  • Deep experience with at least one of Go, Rust, Python or C
  • Conscientiousness and detail orientation, with a focus on performance
  • Excellent communication skills including professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

Depending on your eventual team, you might also bring experience with

  • Container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Highly concurrent, distributed systems
  • Performance engineering – from kernel to web – benchmarks, optimization
  • Software security – fuzzing, tabletop threat models, analysis, audit
  • Build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Public clouds or OpenStack
  • Debian/Ubuntu packaging
  • Systems programming or scalable web services
  • Deep quality and test engineering
  • Web or Flutter front-end experience
  • REST and gRPC API experience
  • SQL and NoSQL data store expertise

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
