title: Software Engineering Manager - Commerce (100% Remote - Brazil)
description:
About the job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) is seeking a smart, creative, and hands-on Engineering Manager to lead a squad dedicated to our high-stakes Enterprise and Corporate B2B partners. You will be at the heart of our mission to revolutionize travel technology for global giants.

In this role, you aren't just a manager—you are a technical steward and a people multiplier . You will lead a high-performing team of talented engineers building complex, distributed systems that handle millions of transactions. You’ll navigate the intersection of technical excellence, enterprise-grade reliability, and the rapid “zero-to-one” pace that defines Hopper.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Hire, mentor, and coach a multidisciplinary squad. You’ll be responsible for building a high-trust culture where engineers are empowered to act like owners.

  • Partner closely with product teams to translate “big-picture” partner needs into executable technical roadmaps. You’ll ensure we ship high-quality features while managing the unique complexities of B2B integrations and public-facing APIs.

  • While you won’t be coding 100% of the time, you will stay deeply technical. You’ll lead architectural reviews, help unblock complex debugging sessions, and ensure our stack remains scalable and resilient.

  • Own the “run” of your team’s services. This means establishing on-call rotations, driving down technical debt strategically, and ensuring our systems meet the strict SLAs required by our enterprise corporate partners.

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for external partners. You must be able to explain complex system constraints to non-technical stakeholders and advocate for the best technical path forward. There may be some travel within North America for client meetings.

You are a perfect fit if you:

  • Have 2+ years of experience leading engineering teams and 7+ years in software development (ideally with JVM/Scala or React experience).

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and can build the “MVP” without sacrificing the long-term integrity of the system.

  • You have experience with microservices, distributed systems, and designing APIs that are robust enough for global enterprise use.

  • You prefer a “ship and iterate” approach. You can distinguish between what needs to be perfect on Day 1 and what can be optimized on Day 30.

  • You find more satisfaction in your team’s success than your individual commits. You have a proven track record of growing junior engineers into seniors and seniors into leads/architects.

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.

  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for the EOR-offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.

  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers

  • Very generous parental leave

  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.

  • Open communication with management and company leadership.

  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Job Purpose

The Senior Talent Partner is a strategic thinker responsible for driving the talent acquisition strategy and execution across the organization. The role involves partnering with senior leadership to understand business needs, developing innovative recruitment strategies, and ensuring the acquisition of top-tier talent. The selected incumbent will lead complex recruitment initiatives and contribute to the overall talent management strategy. The partner is responsible for attracting, sourcing, and selecting top talent to meet the recruitment needs of Howard University. The selected incumbent will provide direct professional support in evaluating applicant work history, education, training, job skills, and other personal qualifications for positions within the university. The Talent Partner will collaborate with hiring managers senior talent acquisition management to create, develop and execute the appropriate recruiting strategies for executive level positions. The selected incumbent will partner with senior leadership to source and hire top executive and technical talent as the needs are identified to help support the university. The position reports to the Manager, Talent Acquisition.

Supervisory Authority

Not applicable

Nature And Scope

Contacts include interfacing internally with a diversified group of University staff. Externally, the incumbent interfaces with a variety of recruitment sources, a multi-cultural and diverse population, as well as professional organizations.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Lead implementation efforts in executing position specific comprehensive recruitment strategies to ensure high-caliber talent is presented in selection pools
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen in joint partnership with senior leadership to understand workforce needs, and align recruitment efforts with specific organizational and departmental objectives
  • Interpret the position specific requirements and translate them into successful recruitment solutions and offerings
  • Evaluate applications, interview applicants, check references, and determine eligibility regarding qualification requirements for positions within the university under the direction of senior talent acquisition management
  • Identify, attract and introduce to university hiring managers, the best and most diverse talent in the marketplace by providing market intelligence
  • Initiate strategic recruitment and regular follow-up meetings with senior leadership and hiring managers to determine the effectiveness and status of the recruiting plans for each position
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders, including senior executives, leadership, hiring managers, candidates, and external partners to create a partnership that yields success, predictable results and credibility of our talent acquisition infrastructure
  • Create a sourcing network through industry contacts, association memberships, professional conferences and hiring executives to help identify and source qualified candidates
  • Research, recommend, and leverage new sources for active and passive candidate recruitment efforts including the internet, social and professional networking sites
  • Provide a complete, accurate, and inspiring value proposition to potential candidates about Howard University, the specific department, and the corresponding available role
  • Implement ongoing creative and cost-effective sourcing strategies and initiatives
  • Review information received concerning position vacancy and leverage collaboration with hiring leadership in preparation for recruitment activities
  • Advise hiring managers if federal or local regulation and official human resources policies and procedures are aligned in their job description compliance review
  • Recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the long-term growth of the university, implementing new processes and fine-tuning standard procedures for recruiting to drive change
  • Review job vacancy requisitions for each corresponding department as assigned
  • Ensure all regulatory and compliance requirements for the federal government, the District of Columbia, and the Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) are met
  • Review references submitted by candidates, completes reference checks and records information received
  • Assess offer of employment letters for selected candidates and notifications of non-selection to ensure accuracy
  • Attend recruitment and talent acquisition seminars, job fairs, and professional organizational conferences to ensure the university is aligned in market trends, the evolving landscape of the higher education industry, and our competitive peer and aspirant institutions
  • Promote the university’s career opportunities to the professional and campus community via networking, job fairs, conference attendance and professional career events
  • Demonstrate the ability to handle a variety of recruitment issues with successful outcomes and demonstrating openness to new ideas
  • Keep abreast of new and updated standards and regulations related to recruitment
  • Perform other related duties as assigned by senior management
Core Competencies
  • Comprehension of current Equal Employment Opportunity laws and regulations as well as federal and local employment law guidelines
  • Lifecycle expertise in applicant tracking systems (e.g. Workday, PeopleSoft, etc.)
  • Excellent analytical, communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of current recruitment principles, procedures, techniques and practices
  • Ability to adhere to policy and procedural changes, and communicate the augmentation to each assigned department or client group
  • Possess a wide degree of creativity and business understanding of the higher education infrastructure
  • Critical thinking, active listening and keen capacity of professional judgment to discern clients’ recruitment needs, and influence hiring managers to provide sound recruitment advice to clients
  • Develop and maintain sourcing pools of highly competent candidates best matched to open job vacancies or future needs for the university
  • Ability to be a supportive and productive team member with a focus on providing professional customer service of the highest quality to applicants, candidates, hiring managers, and colleagues
  • Provide guidance and advisement to the Talent Operations Specialist role to ensure the Talent Partner’s job requisitions, candidate system and overall operational processing of each corresponding department’s positions are completed timely and accurately
  • Establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with faculty, staff, students and candidates
  • High level of professionalism and discretion in handling confidential information
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business or related area 5+ years of recruitment or talent acquisition related experience
  • 8 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications Experience in higher education desired
  • Full lifecycle recruitment experience preferred

title: Senior Media Operations Manager
description:
Senior Media Operations Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Director, Scientific & Regulatory Affairs, Brazil
description:
At The Coca-Cola Company, we are proud to be one of the world’s most recognized and respected brands, with a legacy spanning over 139 years and a portfolio of more than 200 brands enjoyed by millions globally. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference.

We are seeking a Senior Director, Scientific and Regulatory Affairs (SRA) to lead ingredient, nutrition, and regulatory advocacy in Brazil , shaping the external scientific, regulatory, and public policy environment in support of our portfolio and long-term growth strategy. This role is pivotal in protecting business continuity, strengthening stakeholder trust, and enabling science-based decision‑making across the system.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in scientific and regulatory affairs, nutrition science, and public policy advocacy, along with strong enterprise leadership capability and a proven ability to influence outcomes in complex, evolving regulatory environments. If you are passionate about shaping external dialogue and delivering sustainable business impact, we want you on our team.

What You'll Do for Us
  • Lead scientific and regulatory thought leadership, stewardship, and governance for ingredients and nutrition, aligned with global Scientific and Regulatory Affairs (SRA) strategies and standards.
  • Develop and execute short- and long-term advocacy strategies across ingredients, nutrition science, food safety, and emerging regulatory risks, with a primary focus on Brazil and strong alignment to global priorities.
  • Shape the external regulatory and public policy environment by building and sustaining trusted relationships with regulators, policymakers, scientific experts, trade associations, NGOs, and key opinion leaders.
  • Represent The Coca-Cola Company in relevant industry associations, regulatory bodies, and scientific forums, providing leadership and influencing collective action on priority nutrition, food safety, and regulatory issues.
  • Anticipate, assess, and manage scientific and regulatory risks and opportunities, protecting company reputation while enabling portfolio innovation and growth.
  • Partner closely with Public Affairs, Legal, R&D, Marketing, and Franchise Operations to ensure aligned advocacy, issue management, and effective execution.
  • Oversee discretionary budgets and external scientific and regulatory resources, ensuring disciplined investment aligned with regional and global priorities.
  • Build, develop, and retain high-performing Scientific and Regulatory Affairs talent and external capability networks to deliver sustained impact in Brazil.
Requirements & Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Regulatory Science, or a related scientific discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Scientific and Regulatory Affairs, Nutrition Science, Public Policy, or related functions within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), food, beverage, or other regulated industries.
  • Proven experience leading ingredient and nutrition advocacy and engaging effectively with government regulators, policymakers, and scientific communities.
  • Strong enterprise mindset with the ability to lead through influence in complex, matrixed, and multicultural environments.
  • Demonstrated strategic judgment, with the ability to translate scientific insight into clear advocacy, regulatory, and business strategies.
  • Experience managing senior external partnerships, third-party providers, and budgets.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.
  • Willingness to travel as required to support regional and global objectives.
What We'll Do for You
  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with global Scientific and Regulatory Affairs leaders and contribute to enterprise-wide strategies, regulatory positioning, and best practices.
  • Iconic Brands: Help steward and protect one of the world’s most recognized and trusted beverage and consumer brands.
  • Learning & Development: Access world-class learning resources, leadership development programs, and continuous growth opportunities.
  • Purpose-Driven Work: Play a meaningful role in advancing science-based policy, public trust, and sustainable business growth.

Job Description Summary

At The Coca-Cola Company, we are proud to be one of the world’s most recognized and respected brands, with a legacy spanning over 139 years and a portfolio of more than 200 brands enjoyed by millions globally. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference.

We are seeking a Senior Director, Scientific and Regulatory Affairs (SRA) to lead ingredient, nutrition, and regulatory advocacy in Brazil , shaping the external scientific, regulatory, and public policy environment in support of our portfolio and long‑term growth strategy. This role is pivotal in protecting business continuity, strengthening stakeholder trust, and enabling science‑based decision‑making across the system.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in scientific and regulatory affairs, nutrition science, and public policy advocacy, along with strong enterprise leadership capability and a proven ability to influence outcomes in complex, evolving regulatory environments. If you are passionate about shaping external dialogue and delivering sustainable business impact, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do for Us
  • Lead scientific and regulatory thought leadership, stewardship, and governance for ingredients and nutrition, aligned with global Scientific and Regulatory Affairs (SRA) strategies and standards.
  • Develop and execute short‑and long‑term advocacy strategies across ingredients, nutrition science, food safety, and emerging regulatory risks, with a primary focus on Brazil and strong alignment to global priorities.
  • Shape the external regulatory and public policy environment by building and sustaining trusted relationships with regulators, policymakers, scientific experts, trade associations, NGOs, and key opinion leaders.
  • Represent The Coca-Cola Company in relevant industry associations, regulatory bodies, and scientific forums, providing leadership and influencing collective action on priority nutrition, food safety, and regulatory issues.
  • Anticipate, assess, and manage scientific and regulatory risks and opportunities, protecting company reputation while enabling portfolio innovation and growth.
  • Partner closely with Public Affairs, Legal, R&D, Marketing, and Franchise Operations to ensure aligned advocacy, issue management, and effective execution.
  • Oversee discretionary budgets and external scientific and regulatory resources, ensuring disciplined investment aligned with regional and global priorities.
  • Build, develop, and retain high‑performing Scientific and Regulatory Affairs talent and external capability networks to deliver sustained impact in Brazil.
Requirements & Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Regulatory Science, or a related scientific discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Scientific and Regulatory Affairs, Nutrition Science, Public Policy, or related functions within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), food, beverage, or other regulated industries.
  • Proven experience leading ingredient and nutrition advocacy and engaging effectively with government regulators, policymakers, and scientific communities.
  • Strong enterprise mindset with the ability to lead through influence in complex, matrixed, and multicultural environments.
  • Demonstrated strategic judgment, with the ability to translate scientific insight into clear advocacy, regulatory, and business strategies.
  • Experience managing senior external partnerships, third‑party providers, and budgets.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.
  • Willingness to travel as required to support regional and global objectives.
What We’ll Do for You
  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with global Scientific and Regulatory Affairs leaders and contribute to enterprise‑wide strategies, regulatory positioning, and best practices.
  • Iconic Brands: Help steward and protect one of the world’s most recognized and trusted beverage and consumer brands.
  • Learning & Development: Access world‑class learning resources, leadership development programs, and continuous growth opportunities.
  • Purpose‑Driven Work: Play a meaningful role in advancing science‑based policy, public trust, and sustainable business growth.
Our Purpose and Growth Culture

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years.   • Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes.
  • Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega. Isso incluirá alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos.

  • Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal. Utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico.

  • Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.

  • Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques

title: Data Scientist [All Levels]
description:
About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our institutional page

Data Science at Nubank

Data Science is essential to every part of the business at Nubank, since Day 1. Most areas of the company use data science to some extent. Data Scientists are responsible for translating business needs into models and other types of data‑driven solutions.

As a Data Scientist, you’re expected to
  • Interact with other team members to understand how to best apply data science and artificial intelligence to Nubank’s problems;
  • Investigate problems and discover insights through exploratory data analysis and other quantitative methods;
  • Have great numerical and analytical literacy, including knowledge of statistics and linear algebra as needed;
  • Work on multiple stages of the ML model lifecycle–from ideation to training and steady‑state operation;
  • Work across multiple types of models, algorithms and learning paradigms;
  • Communicate technical points, decisions and tradeoffs to peers and stakeholders.
Our ideal candidate
  • Has experience working with ML models in a production environment;
  • Understands possible pitfalls and tradeoffs when applying ML to real‑world, sometimes messy problems;
  • Is familiar with the technical aspects of learning theory and algorithms and is able to discuss details if needed;
  • Has experience working with the Python scientific stack (Numpy, Pandas, Scipy, Sklearn, Boosted Tree Libraries, etc);

description:
About the Role

Mútua is seeking a hands‑on, entrepreneurial, AI‑native Head of Engineering to orchestrate our technical operations and co‑build the company at its next stage of growth. In this role, you will be a core technical partner, building alongside the team to ensure that our technical execution reflects our mission and product vision.

As our Head of Engineering, you will combine leadership and execution. You will lead the software engineering front while deeply engaging with AI Engineering, bringing agentic solutions from prototype to scalable production.

This is a senior leadership role with strong hands‑on execution. You will own architecture, delivery, and production reliability across software, data, and AI systems.

Responsibilities
  • Hands‑on Architecture & Development: Design and build core backend, data, and AI components; review code and contribute to critical features.
  • Team Leadership: Set priorities, mentor engineers, enforce high technical standards, and ensure consistent delivery.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps Collaboration: Work closely with the CTO on cloud architecture, CI/CD, observability, security, and scalability.
  • Agentic AI Prototyping: Partner with the Senior AI Expert to prototype, test, and productionize agentic workflows.
  • AI Productionization: Define orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and reliability standards for AI systems in production.
  • Engineering Operations: Structure agile workflows, remove bottlenecks, and maintain speed with rigor.
  • Technical Governance: Establish pragmatic standards across SDLC, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Cross‑Functional Alignment: Translate product and business needs into clear technical priorities.
About Mútua

Mútua is building a global intelligence infrastructure for the impact ecosystem, powered by AI and collective intelligence. Our platform helps actors navigate complex social and environmental challenges requiring coordinated action across sectors and geographies.

We enable funders, innovators, researchers, and ecosystem actors to align around shared missions, improving how capital is informed and deployed. By structuring knowledge and mapping ecosystems, Mútua supports faster, more accurate, and more transparent funding decisions across critical systems such as food, energy, education, and healthcare.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for a purpose‑driven technical builder with deep execution strength across software, data, and AI:

  • Entrepreneurial Profile: Builder mindset, comfortable in early‑stage ambiguity, aiming to join as a long‑term partner.
  • Technical Depth: Strong track record across backend systems, data engineering, and AI/ML in production environments.
  • Agentic Systems Experience: Proven experience bringing agentic or autonomous AI systems from prototype to scalable production.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps Acumen: Solid experience with cloud, CI/CD, monitoring, reliability, and security best practices.
  • Architectural Judgment: Ability to design AI‑native systems balancing speed, cost, scalability, and robustness.
  • Execution Discipline: Brings structure without slowing momentum; high ownership and delivery focus.
  • Systems Thinking: Understands how technical architecture supports systemic impact at scale.
  • Purpose‑Oriented: Motivated to contribute to the societal sustainability transition aligned with Mútua’s mission.
  • Strong Communication: Clear, direct, and able to align technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
Practical Details

Role: Head of Engineering (Full‑time).

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

At TechnipFMC, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in Floating Offshore Wind — and we’re looking for a visionary engineer to help lead the charge. As a key member of our dedicated R&D team, you’ll play a central role in developing cutting‑edge Medium and High Voltage subsea power cable systems for our Dynamic Inter Array Cable System (DIAC). Working closely with our New Energies business segment, you’ll drive innovation from concept to qualification, helping us deliver world‑leading integrated solutions that will define the future of offshore wind.

This position is open to candidates based in a range of locations , and we welcome applications from talented engineers regardless of where they are currently located. For those interested in the role whom are not based at our Newcastle hub, occasional travel may be required to collaborate with the local team, support testing activities, and contribute to key project milestones.

If you’re passionate about engineering excellence, excited by complex technical challenges, and driven to make a real impact in the renewable energy transition, this is your opportunity to step into a pivotal role at the forefront of industry change.

Job Description

As a High-Medium Voltage Subsea Power Cable Chief Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the development, qualification, and integration of our subsea dynamic power cable products for success of integrated Water Column EPCI offering for Floating Offshore Wind.

Core Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and optimize high and medium voltage power cables.
  • Provide technical governance of the supply chain for power core components.
  • Apply your knowledge of cable manufacturing processes to ensure quality and efficiency.
  • Specifying HV/MV testing to validate cable performance.
  • Analyse long-term performance and failure modes of HV/MV cables.
  • Ensure compliance and have participation with relevant standards (e.g., IEC, CIGRE).
  • Foster a network of experts in this field across clients, suppliers, academia, and industry recognised organisations
  • Developing a clear overview of the operational requirements for the developing floating offshore wind market through engagement with clients and other experts
You are meant for this job if: Essential
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Extensive relevant experience in subsea power cable engineering in the offshore wind and/or oil & gas sectors.
  • Proficiency in power core supply chain management, cable manufacturing, and HV/MV testing.
Desirable (beneficial but not mandatory)
  • Experience in mechanical testing and performance assessment of power cables.
  • Proficiency in electro‑magnetic analysis for cable systems.
  • Knowledge of splicing/jointing power cables.
  • Knowledge of power cables termination techniques for service and testing.

title: Senior Media Operations Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

Key responsibilities

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Maverick Currencies is seeking disciplined traders who want to day trade Forex and Crypto remotely using firm capital. We help bridge the gap between trading alone and trading as part of a professional firm. If you're tired of undercapitalized trading accounts, inconsistent strategies, or isolation, Maverick provides the capital, structure, and community to help you grow. Maverick Currencies is the Forex and Crypto division of Maverick Trading, a proprietary trading firm that has been training and funding traders since 1997. Experiência em gestão bancária, incluindo o upload de arquivos bancários para o portal do Itaú.

Revisar as informações preparadas para lançamentos contábeis e outras atividades de contabilidade e relatórios financeiros associadas à folha de pagamento.

Atuar como recurso interno e externo para consultas relacionadas à folha de pagamento.

Liderar projetos e iniciativas de melhoria contínua; apoiar o desenvolvimento e a manutenção da documentação do processo de folha de pagamento.

Garante a conformidade com os controles internos dos sistemas de folha de pagamento e com a legislação tributária e outras legislações relacionadas à folha de pagamento.

Desejável conhecimento do uso do Celergo Flexiforms.

Preferencialmente, experiência com processos na América Central.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Commerce (100% Remote - Brazil)
description:
About The Job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) is seeking a smart, creative, and hands-on Engineering Manager to lead a squad dedicated to our high-stakes Enterprise and Corporate B2B partners. You will be at the heart of our mission to revolutionize travel technology for global giants. In this role, you aren't just a manager—you are a technical steward and a people multiplier . You will lead a high-performing team of talented engineers building complex, distributed systems that handle millions of transactions. You’ll navigate the intersection of technical excellence, enterprise-grade reliability, and the rapid "zero-to-one" pace that defines Hopper.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like
  • Hire, mentor, and coach a multidisciplinary squad. You’ll be responsible for building a high-trust culture where engineers are empowered to act like owners.
  • Partner closely with product teams to translate "big-picture" partner needs into executable technical roadmaps. You’ll ensure we ship high-quality features while managing the unique complexities of B2B integrations and public-facing APIs.
  • While you won't be coding 100% of the time, you will stay deeply technical. You’ll lead architectural reviews, help unblock complex debugging sessions, and ensure our stack remains scalable and resilient.
  • Own the "run" of your team’s services. This means establishing on-call rotations, driving down technical debt strategically, and ensuring our systems meet the strict SLAs required by our enterprise corporate partners.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for external partners. You must be able to explain complex system constraints to non-technical stakeholders and advocate for the best technical path forward. There may be some travel within North America for client meetings.
You Are a Perfect Fit If You
  • Have 2+ years of experience leading engineering teams and 7+ years in software development (ideally with JVM/Scala or React experience).
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and can build the "MVP" without sacrificing the long-term integrity of the system.
  • You have experience with microservices, distributed systems, and designing APIs that are robust enough for global enterprise use.
  • You prefer a "ship and iterate" approach. You can distinguish between what needs to be perfect on Day 1 and what can be optimized on Day 30.
  • You find more satisfaction in your team’s success than your individual commits. You have a proven track record of growing junior engineers into seniors and seniors into leads/architects.
Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us
  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.
More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Faz análise sensorial da carne, para verificar seu estado de conservação Armazena a carne, identificando cada peça e monitorando a temperatura adequada do ambiente, para evitar sua deterioração. Pode manipular carnes para fabricação de produtos cárneos industrializados Acondiciona carne em embalagens individuais, manualmente ou com o auxílio de máquinas de embalagem a vácuo Registra o recebimento, o armazenamento, a venda e demais informações dos trabalhos realizados Controla e organiza o estoque de produtos cárneos. Transportar as peças da câmara fria até o açougue da loja, acondicionado e organizando as mesmas nas vitrines, geladeiras, freezers e demais expositores do produto, de acordo com as orientações recebidas do superior imediato. Atender com cordialidade os pedidos dos clientes no balcão do açougue, retirando os produtos solicitados das câmaras e/ou vitrines,moendo ou fracionando os tipos de carnes (bovinas, suínas e aves) conforme solicitado, através do emprego de técnicas que minimizem perdas dos produtos, ao mesmo tempo que garanta os padrões de qualidade para a satisfação do cliente. Embalar e pesar os cortes solicitados pelo cliente, digitando os códigos de cada produto, conforme tabela de preço definida pela empresa, bem como imprimir a etiqueta precificada, a fim de colar a mesma nas embalagens de forma apropriada para o devido registro no caixa. Manter os utensílios e equipamentos utilizados no trabalho, tais como:facas, amoladores, ganchos, serras mecânicas e/ou elétricas, vitrines, expositores, etc. , devidamente regulados, limpos e em perfeitas condições de uso e conservação. Zelar pela ordem, limpeza e sanitização do local de trabalho, removendo e descartando o lixo e resíduos em locais apropriados, lavando e higienizando pisos, superfícies, utensílios e os equipamentos utilizados no trabalho, além de observar os procedimentos de segurança, preservação ambiental e asseio pessoal na operação com o uso obrigatório e apropriado dos EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual). Comunicar ao superior imediato quaisquer irregularidade identificadas nos equipamentos do setor, a fim de que o mesmo possa solicitar a devida manutenção. Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e nível de complexidade associadas ao ambiente organizacional. Requisitos para a função:Ensino Fundamental Completo.
